stem.text: In a double-slit interference experiment, light of frequency $6.0 \times 10^{14}\,\text{Hz}$ is incident on a pair of slits. Bright fringes that are $3.0\,\text{mm}$ apart are observed on a screen some distance away.
What is the separation of the bright fringes when the frequency of the light is changed to $5.0 \times 10^{14}\,\text{Hz}$?
